parts.style: calm, reverent, reading scripture aloud slowly
parts.text: Casting all your care upon him; <short pause> for he careth for you. <short pause> First Peter, chapter five, verse seven.

Caring Father, I cast all my worries on You tonight because You truly care for me. <short pause> The burdens I have been carrying are too heavy, but You are strong enough to hold them all. <short pause> I give them to You now and sleep in peace. <short pause> Amen.
